props.title: Gold normalization pass
props.subtitle: The exact six rulebook fixes and fifteen gold-row edits are applied. The FMM sweep is clean; unrelated repository drift keeps the full gate set red.

props.content:
Changed `data/atc/policy/dispatch/command_parameter_contract.yaml`: radar identification, hold for release, cleared option, and frequency change now allow intent-only payloads; hold `time` moved to context; sequencing `pattern_leg` and taxi `facility` moved to executable parameters.

Changed `tests/unit/dispatch/test_dispatch_engine.py`: assertions now encode the new modes and roles. `tests/unit/test_contract_governance.py` required no edit.

props.content: No commit command was issued. While the slice was running, an external checkpoint absorbed the test-file edits into parent commit 7002b099c. The policy file remains dirty in the data submodule.

props.content:
Changed source and review JSON for `360_for_spacing`, `ads_b_traffic_conflict`, `busy_class_d_traffic_saturation`, `closed_traffic_request`, `request_direct_routing`, and `vfr_departure_class_c`. The authority sources live in the `prototype` submodule behind `data/src/partner_graph/sources/partner`; every source byte-matches its review copy.

The receipt CLI refreshed `checked_at` timestamps on the four existing review sidecars and created empty sidecars for `360_for_spacing` and `ads_b_traffic_conflict`. No receipt YAML was hand-edited, and no addendum was recorded because none of the changed payload rows invalidated an existing receipt.

Re-generated only the six matching files under `data/src/partner_graph/output/scenarios/`. No transcript, audio, TTS, or transcription operation ran.

props.title: Exact payload scope preserved
props.content: All fifteen approved payload edits are present, including the pattern-entry reclassification and removal of the expectation-only altitude command. No extra scenario payload edits were introduced.
